data.name: TechInspector_AboutText
data.value: Checks and edits iRacing's settings from inside SimHub. It explains every setting, flags values that look wrong, protects your triple-screen layout from resets, and backs up your files before every change.

data.name: TechInspector_Touch1
data.value: Changes iRacing's files in Documents\iRacing only while the sim is closed, and only when you write changes or restore a backup.

data.name: TechInspector_Touch2
data.value: Backs up those files before every write. Backups stay in SimHub's data folder.

data.name: TechInspector_Touch3
data.value: Moves telemetry files and hand-made copies to the Recycle Bin only when you ask.

data.name: TechInspector_Touch4
data.value: Never changes the sim or its install folder.

data.name: TechInspector_Touch5
data.value: Doesn't connect to the internet. Links open in your browser only when you click them.

data.name: TechInspector_SourceText

data.name: TechInspector_SupportText
data.value: Tech Inspector is free, and built and maintained by one person at Simpatico Sim Shop. Donations keep it current with each iRacing season. Ko-fi opens in your browser.
